title: 第13章 外门将至暗流涌动第14章 告示张贴群雄心动
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 夕阳西垂，余晖染红后山天际。
落日霞光穿过林间枝叶，洒落斑驳光影，给整座青岚宗后山镀上了一层暖色调。
杂役院劳作已然尽数结束，一众弟子扛着农具，三三两两从后山山道折返归来。
劳碌了整日，人人面露疲惫，低声闲谈着家常琐事，步履匆匆赶回各自木屋歇息。
院落间炊烟袅袅升起，混杂着草木与粗粮的淡淡气息，透着底层宗门弟子平凡枯燥的日常。
林宸跟在人群后方，步履从容不迫，神色淡漠如常。
刚刚结束一天伐木劳作，他身上没有半分狼狈，气息平稳，不见丝毫疲累。
寻常杂役整日靠蛮力劈柴挑担，耗费体力极大，每日下来皆是腰酸背痛，精气神损耗严重。
而林宸身负特殊体质，肉身本就远超凡人坚韧。
再加上日日灵气滋养淬炼，体魄早已脱胎换骨，寻常劳作对他而言，根本造不成半点负担。
一路行走，沿途不少弟子瞥见他的身影，都下意识收敛话语，侧身退让。
没人敢上前搭话，也没人敢随意打量，都抱着敬而远之的心态，远远绕开行路。
经历先前数次事端，林宸在杂役院早已树立起无人敢招惹的气场。
冷漠、强大、深不可测，连管事都不愿轻易拿捏，普通弟子更是不敢有半分不敬。
林宸对此全然漠视，早已习惯这般独处疏离的氛围。
他无心融入这群底层弟子的圈子，也不屑参与那些家长里短、是非八卦。
眼下唯一的重心，便是潜心修行，稳固炼气二层修为，默默积累底蕴。
等待宗门外门考核开启，早日挣脱后山杂役的束缚。
一路无话，缓步走回角落的破旧木屋。
抬手轻轻合上木门，瞬间将院落间的喧嚣与人情纷扰隔绝在外。
屋内清静寂寥，光线柔和，自成一方安稳静修小天地。
林宸盘膝坐于木床之上，心神缓缓沉淀下来，摒除外界一切杂念。
连日来每日坚持吐纳打坐，他的炼气二层修为早已打磨得十分扎实。
丹田灵力凝练厚重，经脉通畅无阻，肉身筋骨也在灵气日复一日的浸润下，越发强悍。
他依旧遵循低层境界稳扎稳打的原则，不急于贸然冲击炼气三层。
宁愿把当下层级打磨到圆满极致，再稳步向下一层迈进。
修行之路，最怕急于求成，根基虚浮。
现在多一分沉淀，未来修行路上便能少无数瓶颈阻碍。
闭目凝神，绵长的呼吸缓缓起伏。
天地间稀薄的灵气受无形牵引，悄然向木屋聚拢，顺着周身毛孔缓缓渗入体内。
流转四肢百骸，滋养经脉血肉，一点一滴夯实自身修为根基。
他不刻意追求境界飙升，只顺着自然节奏，水磨慢炖，稳步积累。
时间静静流逝，屋外天色由黄昏转入暮色。
山间晚风渐起，吹动林木沙沙作响，夜色慢慢笼罩整座后山。
杂役院灯火逐一点亮，弟子们大多已用过晚饭，闭门歇息，或是闲聊打发时光。
不少人聚在屋前空地，低声议论起宗门近期的传闻。
最近几日，整个杂役院私下都在流传一件大事——
青岚宗一年一度的外门弟子考核，近几日便要正式开启。
消息一传十，十传百，很快传遍整个后山，成了所有杂役弟子最关心的话题。
对于困在后山日复一日做苦役的杂役而言，踏入外门，便是改变命运唯一的机会。
一旦通过考核，便能脱离繁重劳作，住进前山外门居所。
习得完整修行功法，分配固定下品灵石资源，还能参与宗门授课、秘境试炼。
身份、地位、资源、修行前路，全都截然不同。
无数杂役弟子都把外门考核当成翻身的唯一希望，人人心中满怀期待，又暗自忐忑不安。
content_en:
The sun sets in the west, and the afterglow dyes the sky behind the mountains red.
The setting sun's rays pass through the branches and leaves in the forest, casting mottled light and shadow, giving the entire Qinglan Sect's back mountain a layer of warm tones.
The work in the yard has all ended, and a group of disciples are returning from the back mountain trail in twos and threes carrying farm tools.
After working hard all day, everyone looked exhausted, chatting in low voices about household chores, and hurried back to their respective cabins to rest.
The smoke from the cooking pots curled up in the courtyard, mixed with the faint smell of vegetation and coarse grains, revealing the ordinary and boring daily life of the lower-level sect disciples.
Lin Chen followed the crowd, walking calmly and calmly, with an indifferent expression as usual.
He had just finished a day of logging work, and he didn't look embarrassed at all, his breathing was stable, and he didn't feel any fatigue at all.
Ordinary handymen rely on brute force to chop wood and carry burdens all day long, which consumes a lot of energy. Every day, they suffer from backache and serious loss of energy and spirit.
And Lin Chen has a special physique, and his physical body is far stronger than ordinary people.
Coupled with the daily nourishment and tempering of spiritual energy, his body has long been reborn, and ordinary labor is not a burden to him at all.
Along the way, many disciples caught a glimpse of his figure and subconsciously restrained their words and stepped aside to give way.
No one dared to come up to talk to them, and no one dared to look at them casually. They all kept a respectful distance and stayed far away.
After experiencing several previous incidents, Lin Chen has already established an aura in the courtyard that no one dares to provoke.
He is cold, powerful, and unfathomable. He is not even willing to handle affairs easily, and ordinary disciples dare not be disrespectful at all.
Lin Chen completely ignored this, having long been accustomed to such an atmosphere of solitude and alienation.
He had no intention of integrating into the circle of this group of low-level disciples, and he didn't bother to get involved in those parents who were gossiping about right and wrong.
The only focus at the moment is to concentrate on cultivation, stabilize the second level of Qi Refining, and quietly accumulate knowledge.
Waiting for the sect's outer sect examination to begin, and breaking away from the shackles of the handymen in the back mountain as soon as possible.
Silently, I walked slowly back to the dilapidated wooden house in the corner.
He raised his hand and gently closed the wooden door, instantly isolating the noise and human turmoil in the courtyard.
The house is quiet and lonely, the light is soft, and it is a small peaceful and quiet place of its own.
Lin Chen sat cross-legged on the wooden bed, his mind slowly settling down and getting rid of all distracting thoughts from the outside world.
For the past few days, he has been practicing meditation every day, and his second-level Qi refining cultivation has been polished very solidly.
The spiritual power of Dantian is concentrated and thick, the meridians are unobstructed, and the muscles and bones of the physical body are becoming stronger and stronger day by day under the infiltration of spiritual energy.
He still follows the principle of playing slow and steady in the lower realms, and is not in a hurry to rush to the third level of Qi Refining.
I would rather polish the current level to perfection and then move steadily to the next level.
On the road of spiritual practice, the most fearful thing is that you are eager to seek success and your foundation is empty.
If you accumulate more time now, there will be fewer bottlenecks and obstacles in your future practice.
He closed his eyes and concentrated, taking long breaths that rose and fell slowly.
The thin spiritual energy between heaven and earth is attracted by the invisible force, quietly gathering towards the wooden house, and slowly seeps into the body along the pores of the whole body.
It flows through the limbs and bones, nourishes the meridians, blood and flesh, and consolidates the foundation of one's own cultivation bit by bit.
He does not deliberately pursue a soaring realm, but just follows the natural rhythm, slowly simmering in water, and steadily accumulating.
Time passed quietly, and the sky outside the house turned from dusk to twilight.
The evening wind gradually picked up in the mountains, rustling the trees, and night slowly enveloped the entire back mountain.
The lights in the courtyard were turned on one by one. Most of the disciples had already had dinner, rested behind closed doors, or passed the time chatting.
Many people gathered in the open space in front of the house and whispered about the recent rumors about the sect.
In recent days, a major event has been privately circulated throughout the courtyard——
Qinglan Sect's annual outer disciple examination will officially begin in the next few days.
The news spread quickly to the entire back mountain and became the most concerned topic among all the handyman disciples.
For the handymen who are stuck in the back mountains doing hard labor day after day, stepping into the outer gate is the only chance to change their destiny.
Once you pass the assessment, you can get rid of the heavy work and live in the outer gate of Qianshan.
Acquire complete cultivation techniques, allocate fixed low-grade spiritual stone resources, and participate in sect lectures and secret realm trials.
Identity, status, resources, and path forward for spiritual practice are all completely different.
Countless handyman disciples regard the outer sect examination as the only hope for turning around. Everyone is full of expectations but secretly uneasy.
title_en: Chapter 13: The outer gate is approaching, and the undercurrent is surging. Chapter 14: The notice is posted, and the heroes are excited.
